test_title: PYST 43: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 22 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **established.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in the blank number 1 is established.
 
• **Establish means **setting up on a permanent or firm basis.
 
• Thus the correct answer is established.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Implanted** means **inserting or fixing (tissue or an artificial object) in a person's body, especially by surgery.**
 
• **Founded** means** based on good evidence or reasons.**
 
• **Resurrected **Means **restoring (a dead person) to life**.
